messages:
Priya K.: FYI—customer asks for a short writeup we can send to their security team: they want details on KMS/HSM integration for the POC and evidence of key rotation and auditability. Any quick answers?
Alex M.: short answer: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via import to a FIPS-validated HSM layer, envelope encryption, and automated rotation hooks. happy to draft.
Samir (sales): they also asked whether we ever export raw key material back to them and what the rotation cadence looks like.
Alex M.: we never return raw private key material once imported. import = we wrap with our HSM KEK. rotation cadence is policy-driven: default service rotation for data keys is 90 days, customers can trigger rotation on CMKs any time. for POC we can document exact steps.
Priya K.: security reviewer wants references: FIPS level, SOC2 logging details, and an example of the audit trail they would get.
Alex M.: our HSM fleet uses vendor FIPS 140-2/3 validated modules (we include certs during req). SOC2: all key ops and KMS API calls are logged to immutable audit streams and retained per contract. sample audit snippet below (sanitized):
```
{ "event": "Encrypt", "principal": "svc-redwood-infer", "key_id": "cust-cmk-01", "timestamp": "2026-02-12T14:02:33Z", "action_id": "req-0a1b2c" }
```
Samir (sales): is the audit stream something they can pull into their SIEM?
Alex M.: yes — we ship logs via secure syslog/HTTPS to customer endpoints or S3-compatible buckets; can integrate with Splunk/CloudWatch. we also support signed audit exports for compliance reviews.
Priya K.: they want the minimal set of items for the SIG/CAIQ response: confirmation on at-rest encryption, in-transit TLS certs, BYOK import/export rules, rotation policy, and evidence of HSM validation. Can we make a 1‑page bullet list + attachments?
Alex M.: I'll put together a one-pager. quick bullets we can use now: 1) Data at rest: all model artifacts and customer data written to disks are encrypted with AES-256 using envelope encryption (data key encrypted by CMK in HSM). 2) In transit: TLS 1.2+ with strong ciphers and mTLS where customer requests private deployment. 3) BYOK: supported — customers can import keys via secure import tokens; imported key material is wrapped by our HSM and marked non-exportable. 4) Key rotation: data keys rotate automatically per workload; CMKs rotated per-customer policy (default 90 days). 5) HSM evidence: FIPS cert and vendor attestation included in package.
Samir (sales): can we include a short POC playbook steps so customer security can see mechanics? they like step lists.
Alex M.: yep — suggested POC steps:
1) Customer generates CMK in their HSM/KMS (or we provide import token).
2) If BYOK import: customer wraps CMK with our import-wrapping public key and uploads via secure channel.
3) We register key ID in tenant and set non-exportable flag.
4) Run sample encrypt/decrypt calls; capture audit logs (we provide sanitized sample logs).
5) Validate rotation: trigger rotation and show new key thumbprint + audit entry.
Priya K.: nice. can you paste the exact API call we tell them to use for rotation during POC? they'll ask for an example.
Alex M.: example (POST to our control plane):
```
POST /v1/keys/cust-cmk-01/rotate
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{
  "rotation_policy": "immediate"
}
```
Samir (sales): any blockers for enterprise customers who require on-prem HSM?
Alex M.: we have Private deployment options: either 1) deploy our control plane and runtime into their VPC with connectors to their HSM, or 2) fully air-gapped on-prem package where keys never leave their HSM. in both cases we map key IDs to tenant and still provide the same audit surface.
infra-bot: Documentation: https://docs.internal.redwood/kms/best-practices (access: sales/doc-view). Attachments: FIPS-certs.pdf, SOC2-audit-summary.pdf, KMS-api-samples.md
Priya K.: perfect — Samir, can you send this one-pager + the two attachments to the customer's security team, ask if they need the certs notarized? also ask whether they want us to perform the import or have their infra do it. i'll approve before sending.
Samir (sales): will do, pinging them now. thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya K.: thanks — will follow up if security has follow-ups.
(Reaction: :white_check_mark: from Alex M.)
